plan.name: v1.9.1-query-fix
plan.info: Bridge query endpoint fixes and orchestrator improvements

title: Upgrade: v1.9.1-query-fix
summary:
This upgrade fixes bridge query endpoints and improves orchestrator reliability.

Bridge Query Fixes:
- CLI: `miraged q bridge minted` now correctly requires destination_chain parameter
- REST: Added GetBridgeMinted handler to REST gateway (was returning 'Not Implemented')
- Proto: QueryBridgeMintedResponse now includes attestation progress fields (found, attestors, attested_power, required_power)

Orchestrator Fixes:
- Query existing destination_tx before minting to prevent race conditions between validators
- Handle AlreadyMinted marker from Solana by recovering destination_tx from chain
- Added destination_tx mismatch to permanent errors list to prevent infinite retries

These fixes enable the frontend to properly display attestation progress during bridging.

BINARY REQUIREMENT: All validators must update to the v1.9.1 binary BEFORE the upgrade height.
